# Shastrakulam

> Authentic Vedic education platform offering live online Sanskrit courses, Bhagavad Gita and Upanishad classes, Vedic mathematics, and full-time gurukul schooling for children and adult seekers.

Shastrakulam is led by Acharya Yogesh Bhardwaj. Programs run in English, Hindi, and Sanskrit.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of courses, programs, and the gurukul.
- [Courses](/courses): All live online courses.
- [Spoken Sanskrit](/courses/spoken-sanskrit): Beginner-friendly conversational Sanskrit course.
- [Bodhika](/bodhika): 6-month Sanatan Dharma program for children aged 6–12.
- [Gurukul Camp 2026](/camps/gurukul-2026): Residential Vedic camp for children.
- [Camps](/camps): Immersive learning camps.
- [Programs](/programs): Long-form learning programs.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on Sanskrit, dharma, and Vedic learning.
- [About](/about): Founder and mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team (+91 86794 41338).
- [Donate](/donate): Support the gurukul.
